messages:
Sam: hi team, I'm Sam (started today). Quick Q: where do I post setup issues vs product questions vs ops alerts? Also some bots keep DMing me after I joined - how do I mute them without losing paging alerts?

Jules: welcome Sam! TL;DR: setup & access -> #help (or DM IT with screenshot), product questions -> #product-question or the relevant squad channel, ops/alerts -> #incidents or @oncall depending on severity.

Sam: thanks. what about infra noise like build failures? are those incidents?

Harper: build failures go to #build-failures (non-urgent). If it affects prod -> escalate to #incidents and @oncall. For noisy CI bots, we usually mute the channel and rely on the deploy bot to page on failures.

IT-Bot: Hello Sam! To complete onboarding, run the following:

```
$ rwi-setup --apply
$ rwi-auth login
```

Reply "done" when finished.

Sam: ran it. saw a permission denied on docker socket. who do I ping?

Jules: ping @Harper or open a ticket in #help and tag "infra". Paste the error (one line) and your machine id.

Sam: copied. about muting bots - I still want security alerts and pages to get through.

Harper: go to channel details -> Notifications -> "Customize". For specific integrations, click the app and choose to mute messages but keep app mentions. For global control, set Slack "Notification keywords" to include @oncall so pages still break through.

devops-bot: New repo invite: sam has been added to rwi-infra. See repo: https://git.example/rwi-infra

Sam: perfect. one more: introducing myself - should I post in #introductions or drop a short note in my team channel?

Jules: both is fine. Post a short intro in #introductions (name, role, timezone, what you're excited about). In your team channel, add a sentence about what you'll be working on so people know who to ping.

Harper: extras: 1) use threads for follow ups, 2) keep messages searchable (link PR/issue), 3) use reactions for ack, not replies.

Sam: super helpful, thanks everyone! I'll post intros and file the docker ticket. :rocket:
